name: Hight Quality Realistic Girl Character
author: hammer.gamedev
status: User authorized continuing integration on 2026-10-18. Included in quality master and reduced web scene.
changes: User-requested approximately50% reduction of chest projection, blended consistently over body, top, jacket and all morph targets. Original source untouched. Source skeleton/face morphs retained. Seated torso turn24 degrees and forward placement corrected. Eight source-mask-weighted hair helpers; baked effective-gravity springs,4.4cm effective bounded belt slack; uniform88% pelvis-centred scale for cabin clearance; scalp/root pinning and limited hair travel, head/torso/leg reactions, bracing two-link arm targets, animated fingers/wrists/eyes/blinks/brows/mouth and breathing. Shoulder and lap webbing fitted to torso skin each physical frame through42 control bones with fixed chassis anchors. Web-only hair reduction/texture compression. Bounded visual approximation, not full cloth or validated occupant biomechanics. Arm IK uses actual joint-head distances rather than source display-bone lengths. Local seated bases, stable poles, damped bracing and quaternion hemisphere continuity; validated1321integer/half frames.
